_about: Public-domain Samuel H. Virgin, Congregational minister in New York, for the Word Hoard: Mastership of the Sea (a discourse before the American Seamen's Friend Society) and Spiritual Sanity and Other Sermons. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 127 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
